Fixes #12008 

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
The webhook couldn't be up and ready sometimes, that is why we have this issue. The fix is to have dry run that tries to create yaml, and it tries until success which in turn means that webhook is up and running and we can create yaml objects now

## Walkthrough

Two e2e test setup scripts now wait for the Kueue webhook to be available before creating resources, and guard process cleanup to prevent errors when setup exits early. This resolves webhook connection failures and kill command errors observed in test runs.

## Changes

**E2E Test Setup Resilience**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Webhook readiness polling** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-kueueviz-backend.sh`, `hack/testing/e2e-kueueviz-local.sh` | Both scripts now retry a server-side dry-run `kubectl create` before applying resources, waiting for the Kueue webhook to become available and accept requests. |
| **Defensive process cleanup** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-kueueviz-backend.sh`, `hack/testing/e2e-kueueviz-local.sh` | Both scripts now guard `kill` calls with conditional checks, executing termination only when PID variables are non-empty to prevent errors during early exit. |

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes
